info.title: Südhang Clinic Extension – own implementation contract
info.description: New Speakr clinic extension to implement, not existing Speakr or ines endpoints. Reuse upstream session/storage/queue handlers behind these policy envelopes, do not build a second generic media engine. Development values; synthetic data only until production gates. All replies Cache-Control: no-store. All objects require object-level policy and trusted ingress channel. No patient content in logs or URLs. Unsuitable vendor APIs must be adapted behind internal interfaces, not assumed.

post.description: source_kind=simulator only in dev. Agent cannot assign arbitrary owner; source observations untrusted. Browser owner comes from OIDC. If source identity unresolved, persist ingest without a falsely owned Recording. Request_id and Idempotency-Key must match.

put.summary: Append or idempotently replay one original byte segment
put.description: Max body 4 MiB in this file-upload contract. Larger browser MediaRecorder blobs are split at transport level without transcoding. Replaying same sequence+hash succeeds; different bytes conflicts. Hash is SHA-256 of exact body. Do not decode in web process. Reuse storage/session service.

200.description: Success; not proof of backup protection or clinical/vendor acceptance unless explicitly stated.

post.summary: Finalize ordered bytes and record durable receipt
post.description: Sequence must be contiguous from zero and hashes, total bytes and complete hash must match. STORED requires durable original plus committed DB, audit and job intent. Decoding may still be pending; STORED is not automatically SUBMITTED or PROTECTED. Timeout => query existing ingest, not create fresh. source_finished_reading does not prove EOL. For browser source require media_segments and segment_index/blob_index/blob_part_index per chunk. Validate non-overlapping contiguous segment/chunk maps and closed recorder instances. A new recorder instance is not blindly byte-concatenated with another container: decode each complete segment and combine only validated audio in sequence. Interrupted or missing segments require an explicit incomplete-state review, never silently claim completeness.

browserSession.name: session
browserSession.description: Clinical browser session after permitted local authentication or enabled, validated OIDC. Existing User.id, per-account login policy, revocable server-side session, CSRF and object policy required. Initial profile is local. This is an implementation requirement, not a claim about stock Speakr.

machineMTLS.description: Verified at trusted ingress; immutable principal/scopes forwarded only by trusted proxy. Agent and KIS service have separate scopes.

Idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency.description: Scope: actor + operation + aggregate. Persist key and request hash atomically. Reuse with different payload => 409. Not a global audio deduplication key.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Current opaque ETag. Stale => 412; absent => 428. Update state and audit in one transaction.

Csrf.name: X-CSRFToken
Csrf.description: Required on unsafe browser-session requests. Native mTLS requests have no browser cookies and are exempt. Missing/invalid browser token => 403.

subject_reference.description: Trusted KIS actor reference scoped by source_system/tenant_reference. Resolve via explicit actor mapping to existing User.id. Not assumed to be an Entra/OIDC subject; local user sessions are supported.

404.description: Not found or concealed unauthorized object

x-contract-rules.idempotency_default_retention: Development 7 days, production set by approved policy; delivery/source identity ledger retained independently.
x-contract-rules.text_hash_canonicalization: UTF-8 of editor serialized plain text, LF line endings, Unicode NFC; no trimming or semantic rewriting. Document format version and this normalization version persist with release.
x-contract-rules.public_upstream_api: All unclassified legacy routes denied in CLINIC_MODE.
x-contract-rules.development_mocks: Enabled only in dev-mock profile. Production mock refusal is a required startup test.

x-identity-contract: identity-contract.json; existing guarded auth routes reused; not extra clinical login endpoints
